title: Zcash targets November 5 upgrade to accelerate private payments
dek: The Zcash network is planning to activate the NU7 upgrade on November 5, 2026, reducing block times to 25 seconds. The upgrade will also set aside at least 60% of transaction fees beginning in 2031 to supplement mining rewards after the next halving, preserving the existing halving schedule through community consensus.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: NU7 mainnet activation on November 5, 2026 cuts block times to 25 seconds and defers recycled transaction fees to 2031 to sustain mining incentives post-halving.
bottom_line: Zcash miners and users will see faster block finality on November 5 if the upgrade deploys as scheduled. The real test is whether the fee-recycling model sustains hash rate growth after 2031, when mining rewards drop and the ecosystem must rely on both transaction volume and the formal fee supplement.
body:
Zcash is set to activate the NU7 upgrade on November 5, 2026, reshaping the network's transaction speed and post-halving economics in a single push.
The NU7 roadmap consolidates three major changes: the 25-second block time, preservation of existing halving intervals, and integration of the fee mechanism. These elements emerged from developer consensus and a community vote on how to handle post-halving mining incentives without breaking the chain's original halving schedule.
For proof-of-work privacy chains, the halving creates a structural risk: block rewards decline by 50%, and if fees do not rise to fill the gap, miner revenue drops sharply. Zcash's solution directs a portion of future transaction fees into a supplemental pool for miners, reducing the risk of hash rate collapse after the next halving while keeping the reward curve intact.
The November 5 target gives the network two months to finalize code review, testnet validation, and exchange coordination before activation.
